verdict.rationale: The evidence shows least-privilege building blocks: Unity Catalog enforces access control on every table query and model call, privileges can be granted on objects, and agents get 'governed access' to tools and MCP servers they authenticate to. AI Gateway controls which AI services teams can use. None of the evidence describes actually issuing a scoped API credential (token, service principal or OAuth client) to an agent, so least privilege is only implied through governance, not through credential issuance. missing for 10: documented creation of agent-specific scoped credentials (service principals, scoped or expiring tokens, OAuth scopes), a link between those credentials and Unity Catalog grants, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
